title: DIGIWERK in the start-up animation (base 0.2)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: emulator-tested only. The start-up animation warps the DIGIWERK mark (B-two-lines) where it warped Elektron's logo, the right way up (0.1 drew it upside down: the panel's rows run up); the static screen before it (the logo and the OS version) is untouched. Our own pixel letters. For dn2-cfw's base 0.2.
